text:
marta: quick design review: updated routing policies editor to include a collapsible help bar at top, denser rule chips, and a disabled preview overlay when validation fails. need accessibility + copy sanity check. figma: https://figma.mock/abc

henry: nice. two concerns: the help bar is 68px tall on desktop and covers the top rule when keyboard focusing. can it collapse to 36px when keyboard nav is used? also chips look slightly low contrast at 14px.

zoe: ran a contrast check: chip bg #F1F5F9 with text #111827 = 3.9:1 at 14px. fails WCAG. options: darken text to #0B1220 (4.6:1) or adjust bg to #E8EEF6. prefer darkening text to keep palette consistent.

marta: agree with zoe, keep density and darken text. henry: collapsing help bar on keyboard focus is doable. preference: auto-collapse on scroll and on focus into rules list.

kai: small copy nit: current banner says "Fix rules to preview". Suggest: "Resolve rule issues to enable preview"  more descriptive and better for screen readers. also the preview overlay should be aria-hidden when disabled and we should add aria-live polite for validation updates.

ui-bot: accessibility checklist added: aria-live for validation, aria-hidden on preview region when overlay active, focus management to keep focused item visible under help bar.

marta: decision: text -> #0B1220 at 14px; help bar collapses to 36px on scroll or keyboard focus; preview toggle disabled with inline banner copy per kai; implement aria-live + aria-hidden + focus scrolling. kai/zoe open a PR with CSS tokens, aria updates, and screenshots for visual-regression. thanks :thumbsup:
